scene.action: Peter steps from the boat's edge onto the surface of the sea, toward Jesus
scene.setting: Open Sea of Galilee at night, rough water between a fishing boat and the distant shore
scene.secondaryElements: Jesus standing on the waves in the distance, lit by faint radiance; the disciples gathered at the boat's rail; the boat rocking in the swells with a small oil lamp glowing
scene.mood: Tense wonder, faith mixed with uncertainty, awe and quiet courage
scene.timeOfDay: Night, stormy with gusting wind, dim moonlight and starlight breaking through clouds
scene.composition: Low eye-level view from the boat's side, Peter in the near middle ground stepping out, Jesus small and luminous farther across the water, boat framing the left edge

packet.verseText: God said, “Let there be light,” and there was light.

availableCast.name: God / Yahweh, the Father and God of Israel

scene.primarySubject: Pale radiance spreading across the dark deep, emerging from above and beyond the frame
scene.action: First light breaks through the darkness, pushing back the blackness over the waters
scene.setting: Formless void of dark waters stretching without edge, bare and empty, no land or shore
scene.secondaryElements: Dark water surface catching the first glow, faint mist rising in the emptiness
scene.mood: Awe, stillness and quiet hope at the moment of beginning
scene.timeOfDay: Primordial darkness giving way to first light, still air with no wind
scene.composition: Wide low viewpoint over the water, vast dark expanse filling the lower frame, light entering from the upper distance

packet.verseText: The children of Israel went into the middle of the sea on the dry ground; and the waters were a wall to them on their right hand and on their left.

availableCast.name: The Israelite people (the children of Israel)
God / Yahweh, the Father and God of Israel

scene.primarySubject: The Israelite people, families and herders in woven tunics and cloaks, walking across the dry sea-floor in a long column.
scene.action: They advance steadily through the middle of the sea between towering walls of water, carrying children and bundles.
scene.setting: The dry bed of the Red Sea at night, with sand and wet stone underfoot and the parted waters rising high on both sides.
scene.secondaryElements: Moses in plain cloak with staff stands near the front edge of the path, arm lowered. Spray and sand blow across the open ground. Pillar of fire light lies over the water walls.
scene.mood: Awe, tense hope and quiet determination.
scene.timeOfDay: Night, lit by radiance and cloud glow, with the strong east wind blowing through.
scene.composition: Wide view from the side of the path, the column of people receding toward the far shore, water walls framing both edges.

packet.verseText: He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters.

availableCast.name: David son of Jesse (king of Israel)

scene.primarySubject: David reclining on his side on green grass, relaxed and at rest
scene.action: Lying down to rest, one hand loosely holding his rustic staff while gazing toward the calm water
scene.setting: Rolling green hill pasture of Judea with a still water pool
scene.secondaryElements: A few sheep grazing and lying nearby, distant village rooftops on the hills
scene.mood: Peaceful, restful, quietly trusting
scene.timeOfDay: Early morning, sun newly risen, clear and calm sky
scene.composition: Medium-wide shot at ground level, David in the lower foreground beside the water, pasture and hills stretching behind

packet.verseText: Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, and Yahweh caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all night, and made the sea dry land, and the waters were divided.

availableCast.name: The Israelite people (the children of Israel)
God / Yahweh, the Father and God of Israel

scene.primarySubject: Moses in a plain cloak, staff in his other hand, arm stretched out over the sea
scene.action: The strong east wind drives the sea back and the waters stand divided, leaving dry ground between them
scene.setting: The shore of the Red Sea opening into a dry sea-floor between two walls of standing water, with wilderness sand and rock at the edges
scene.secondaryElements: Israelites in woven tunics and cloaks gathering at the shore; the east wind driving sand and spray across the open ground; radiance and cloud glowing in the night air above the parted waters
scene.mood: Awe, tense hope and reverent wonder
scene.timeOfDay: Night, with the strong east wind blowing through until dawn; dark clouds overhead
scene.composition: Wide view from the shore looking out over the dry path, Moses in the foreground near the edge, the parted waters rising on either side

packet.verseText: The wolf will live with the lamb, and the leopard will lie down with the young goat, the calf, the young lion, and the fattened calf together; and a little child will lead them.

scene.primarySubject: A small child standing at the front, leading the calm group of animals
scene.action: A wolf rests beside a lamb, and a leopard lies down with a young goat, all at peace together
scene.setting: A terraced hill village in rural Judah with stone walls and a dry ridge
scene.secondaryElements: A calf and a young lion resting nearby, a shepherd's staff in the foreground, a small stone town gate in the distance
scene.mood: Peaceful, hopeful and tender
scene.timeOfDay: Early morning, first dawn light, clear and still with thin high cloud
scene.composition: Wide view from slightly above, with the child centered and the animals arranged around them in the lower foreground

packet.verseText: Yahweh prepared a huge fish to swallow up Jonah, and Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.

availableCast.name: God / Yahweh, the Father and God of Israel

scene.primarySubject: Jonah in a simple wet tunic, half-submerged, being taken into the great fish's open mouth
scene.action: Jonah slips beneath the dark waves as the huge fish rises to swallow him
scene.setting: Open stormy sea at night, far from shore, with a Tarshish-bound ship nearby
scene.secondaryElements: Sailors in plain soaked tunics and cloaks gripping the rail of the ship; spray and foam around the fish; a faint diffuse glow spread through the water and the fish's interior, as if from distant light or cloud
scene.mood: Awe, fear and solemn humility, with quiet dignity rather than spectacle
scene.timeOfDay: Night in violent storm, with lightning flashes over the waves and a faint diffuse glow
scene.composition: Low wide viewpoint over the water, Jonah and the fish centered, the ship and crew at the edge of the frame

packet.verseText: The pig, because it has a split hoof, and is cloven-footed, but doesn’t chew the cud, is unclean to you.

availableCast.name: God / Yahweh, the Father and God of Israel

scene.primarySubject: Moses and Aaron standing side by side, facing the camp, attentive and still.
scene.action: They listen in silence while a pig roots in the sand at the camp's edge, the moment of divine instruction held quietly.
scene.setting: Wilderness camp of Israel, tents and the tabernacle among rocky sand and scrub, with distant hills.
scene.secondaryElements: Israelite men and women in woven tunics and cloaks gathered at a respectful distance; a single pig in the sand; Aaron in plain priestly linen and Moses in a simple cloak.
scene.mood: Reverent, quiet and solemn, with a sense of careful attention.
scene.timeOfDay: Midday, bright steady daylight with clear dry air and a faint desert haze.
scene.composition: Wide view from the side of the camp, with Moses and Aaron in the foreground and the tents and hills receding behind them.

packet.verseText: When he had said this, he cried with a loud voice, “Lazarus, come out!”

availableCast.name: Jesus Christ, the Son of God and Lord

scene.primarySubject: Jesus standing at the tomb mouth, arm raised toward the entrance, face lifted in a loud call
scene.action: Lazarus, wrapped in grave linens, emerges from the dark tomb toward the light as Jesus calls him out
scene.setting: A rock-cut tomb at the edge of Bethany, with a stone mouth and the great stone rolled back
scene.secondaryElements: Crowd of Jewish mourners and onlookers in dusty tunics and cloaks at a distance, Martha near the front in quiet awe, linen wrappings clinging to Lazarus
scene.mood: Awe, hushed expectancy and grief giving way to wonder
scene.timeOfDay: Late afternoon turning toward dusk, clear and still, warm low sun slanting through the tomb entrance
scene.composition: Tomb opening framed at center-left with Jesus facing it from the right, crowd spread across the foreground, light falling from the entrance onto the figures

packet.verseText: Above him stood the seraphim. Each one had six wings. With two he covered his face. With two he covered his feet. With two he flew.

availableCast.name: God / Yahweh, the Father and God of Israel

scene.primarySubject: Isaiah, a plain-robed man, standing low and still before the sanctuary
scene.action: Two winged seraphim hover above him, veiling their faces and feet with wings while the other wings lift them
scene.setting: Inside the great cedar and stone temple hall in Jerusalem, with a raised sanctuary
scene.secondaryElements: Rising incense smoke and radiance filling the sanctuary and spreading through the hall, coming from beyond the frame, with no visible shape of the divine presence; faint dust stirred in the air
scene.mood: Awe, reverence and quiet dread
scene.timeOfDay: Early morning dawn light through the temple court, still incense-thick air
scene.composition: Low viewpoint from behind and beside Isaiah, looking up at the hovering seraphim toward the glowing sanctuary, the figures framed by the temple columns

packet.verseText: That disciple therefore whom Jesus loved said to Peter, “It’s the Lord!” So when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he wrapped his coat around himself (for he was naked), and threw himself into the sea.

availableCast.name: Jesus Christ, the Son of God and Lord
James and John, sons of Zebedee

scene.primarySubject: Simon Peter mid-leap, cloak clutched around his shoulders, body angled forward over the water
scene.action: Peter plunges from the boat's side into the shallow surf, splashing toward the shore
scene.setting: Shallow shoreline of the Sea of Galilee beside a small wooden fishing boat, sand and stones at the water's edge
scene.secondaryElements: Jesus standing on the sand by a charcoal fire; the beloved disciple pointing from the boat; fishing nets and oars in the boat; ripples spreading from the splash
scene.mood: Urgent joy and reverent eagerness
scene.timeOfDay: Early morning, dawn light over the lake, clear calm air with light mist lifting off the water
scene.composition: Low side view from the lake, Peter in the foreground mid-air against the water, Jesus small on the shore in the distance, boat at the edge of the frame

packet.verseText: Then Yahweh rained on Sodom and on Gomorrah sulfur and fire from Yahweh out of the sky.

scene.primarySubject: Mud-brick cities of Sodom and Gomorrah under a rain of fire and sulfur
scene.action: Burning sulfur and fire streak down from a bright sky onto the cities
scene.setting: Wide valley of the Jordan plain with distant mud-brick cities and dry wild land
scene.secondaryElements: Smoke and orange glow rising from the cities; a few distant hills; no visible people in the foreground
scene.mood: Awe-struck, grave and terrible, with solemn grief
scene.timeOfDay: Dawn turning to full morning, sun just over the eastern hills, clear sky with haze of smoke and ash
scene.composition: Wide view from a high vantage across the plain, cities small in the valley below the falling fire
